messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Prod-west-1 kv-cache error-rate spike detected. Allocation errors + latency cliff for long-context requests. Paging oncall.
maria: @tina you were next, paging now — can you take?
tina: on it. grabbing logs and dashboards, starting a live tail of allocator metrics.
alex: FYI runtime team seeing contiguous drop in free arena segments and rising frag_ratio in telemetry. looks like continuous-batching growth + eviction pressure.
ben: seeing customer 503s and 500s for heavy-ctx models around the same time window. sending list of impacted customers to ops.
linda: copying recent commit that rolled a batching optimizer yesterday — might be related: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/commit/afe2c3
maria: can we toggle continuous batching off for prod-west-1 as a quick mitigation? last time that helped reduce pressure.
tina: yes, preparing a config override. will push to the runtime config service then kick a small restart if needed.
alex: quick note — we observed CUDA malloc failures in logs matching the spike. patching arena tuning may be needed too.
ben: customer impact: ~0.8% of total requests in the region returned 5xx during the spike window; a handful of high-throughput customers reported degraded p95/p99 latency.
sre-carlos: tagging support: @linda please draft a short customer-facing note once we stabilize.

maria: command I'm going to run to flip continuous batching off (dry-run first):

```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CONF_TOKEN" \
  https://config.redwood/api/v1/services/kv-cache/overrides \
  -d '{"continuous_batching": false, "max_batch_tokens": 256}'
```

maria: applying now.
deploy-bot: override applied to cluster prod-west-1 (scope: kv-cache). starting staged rollout to 20% nodes.

tina: monitoring allocator logs. still seeing elevated frag_ratio but allocation failures dropping immediately after override — good sign.

alex: while we have a window, let's reduce max_batch_size on the heavy-ctx route and enable arena compaction more aggressively.

maria: pushing small override for arena_compact_threshold = 0.55 and max_batch_size = 32 for routes: /v1/generate-heavy

```
curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/v1/services/kv-cache/overrides \
  -d '{"arena_compact_threshold": 0.55, "route_overrides": {"/v1/generate-heavy": {"max_batch_size": 32}}}'
```

deploy-bot: canary apply successful on 10% nodes. no errors in canary logs after 2 minutes.

ben: customer error counts dropping. p95 tail latency trending down from +2.4s peak to +0.3s delta vs baseline.

tina: still seeing fragmentation in older arenas. scheduling a rolling restart of small subset to allow arenas to release. doing a slow 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% rollout.

```
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deployment/kv-cache-prod --context=prod-west-1
# monitor pods for warmup and successful health checks
```

alex: also creating an emergency branch to revert yesterday's batching optimizer change and instrument arena alloc/free hot counters — we'll hotfix if mitigations don't fully remove the pressure.

linda: customer note draft: "We experienced intermittent request failures and elevated latency in prod-west-1 affecting a small subset of long-context workloads. We've deployed mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a root cause update." sending to legal for a quick ok.

sre-carlos: go ahead and send once Tina confirms stability for 30 minutes.

maria: deploy-bot reports rollout reached 25% with normal health. continuing.

ben: graphs: free_chunks increased after restarts, allocation-fails dropped to near-zero. looks stable so far.

tina: confirming 35m since mitigations applied — error rate at baseline. I'm keeping pager open for 60 more minutes for verification.

alex: opened PR with revert + additional telemetry: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/4892 — will merge after we confirm no regressions in canary.

maria: action items to capture in incident ticket: toggle continuous-batching revert plan, arena tuning defaults, add auto-compact when frag_ratio > 0.6, more KV eviction telemetry per-customer.

linda: created incident ticket INC-2026-241 in tracker with initial severity and customer list.

sre-carlos: support queued the customer message; will send after Tina signs off.

deploy-bot: canary merge check: 0 failures across 6 health probes.

maria: closing pager (for immediate oncall) but keeping incident open for full postmortem. will assign to Alex + Tina for root cause and long-term fix.

alex: planning follow-ups: add ML for batch-sizing suggestions, guardrails in optimizer to avoid unbounded growth, and a stress test focused on long-context steady loads.

tina: I'll collect heap dumps and allocator histograms for postmortem and attach to INC-2026-241.

ben: thanks all. I'll update support threads with the short note.

maria: great work. set a follow-up postmortem meeting for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-241 assigned severity: S2, responders: tina, alex, maria. Postmortem scheduled.
